name: Pinecone
shortDescription: Managed vector database. Starter is free, and Builder is $20 per month.
longDescription: Pinecone is a managed vector database used in retrieval stacks. Starter is free, and Builder is $20 per month.
pricingNotes: Confirm Starter vs free on pinecone.io/pricing.
bestFor: Hosted vector search inside a RAG stack
Teams that do not want to run the database themselves
notIdealFor: Web search or page crawling, which other tools cover
strength: Starter is free for hosted vector search, and Builder is $20 per month with a 3-week trial.
weakness: Builder is $20 per month after the 3-week trial.

useCaseFit.research-rag: Hosts vectors for search over your documents, with a free Starter plan.
